prompt:
The section file sections/logo-list.liquid shows a row of partner/brand logos. Its markup already reads section.settings.heading, section.settings.columns and, for each block, block.settings.image, block.settings.alt and block.settings.link. The current schema is incomplete: it has no columns or link setting, no block limit, and an empty preset. Do not change any markup. Only replace the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block at the end of the file so that it is exactly the following, with keys and array entries in this order:

Top level:
- "name": "Logo list"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "logo-list-section"
- "settings": an array of two settings:
  1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Trusted by"
  2. type "range", id "columns", label "Logos per row", min 2, max 6, step 1, default 4 (all numbers are JSON integers, not strings)
- "blocks": an array with exactly one block definition: type "logo", name "Logo", settings:
  1. type "image_picker", id "image", label "Logo image"
  2. type "text", id "alt", label "Alt text"
  3. type "url", id "link", label "Link"
  (no defaults on any block setting)
- "max_blocks": 12 (integer)
- "presets": an array with one preset: name "Logo list", blocks: three entries, each {"type": "logo"}

No other keys may appear anywhere in the schema. Change only sections/logo-list.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
